description: On a poll that shows who voted, add someone who asked to be on the list of names, or turn them down (needs the manage key). Check with the person before deciding for them.

approve.description: true adds the name to the poll's list so they can vote; false turns it down.

manageKey.description: The manage key create_poll returned for this poll.

poll.description: The poll's link (https://usepickly.com/p/…) or its id.
